confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge, not live listings or booking pages. Restaurant, cafe, and bar anchors are moderately reliable; July hostel and hotel rates are least certain given peak-season and tourist-area variation. EUR prices converted at about 1.16 USD per EUR as a working assumption; accommodation assumes VAT and city tourist tax are included. Cocktail and wine were checked against the beer anchor (about 2.8x and 1.3x). The FX value came from search-result text attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page, not a direct page read; that text also contained an embedded formatting instruction, which I ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Values reflect general knowledge of Lisbon price levels, positioned relative to other Southern European capitals with similar summer tourism demand, such as Porto and Madrid.
